svg.aria-label: S6 The direction predictor as TAGE
svg.text: S6 The direction predictor as TAGE

A base table and six tagged tables indexed by the PC hashed with longer and longer slices of a 100-branch path history. The longest matching table provides. The history construction is Firestorm's own.
conditionals fold PC bits 2 to 24 and the offset
indirects fold PC bits 2 to 5 and 25 to 30
XOR the branch bits into the low end
PC bits 18:2 index and tag, and bit 6 splits the tables.
◇ T0 to T6 hold about 44,000 entries in all.
longest table with a tag hit
next longest hit, else the base
provider, or alternate when it is weak
indices and state carried to retire
train only on the resolved branch

Knowledge base: dirpred.tables, dirpred.history, dirpred.counter_bits, dirpred.history_update, dirpred.history_inputs, dirpred.capacity, dirpred.mispredict_penalty, tage_tables, path_history_shift_xor, retire_time_training
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
